finish_summary: Shipping fee always returns 60 regardless of subtotal or member flag, violating spec; parse_coupon rejects valid codes like SAVE10 and 5OFF, raising ValueError instead of returning percent; bulk_discount_percent returns incorrect discount (5% for qty 20 instead of 10%); Cart.total misapplies discounts and shipping leading to inflated totals. Empty cart still incurs shipping fee in implementation.
